title: He's more than enough

lines.text: Go free in the name of Jesus,
Be whole in the name of the Lord,
Act on His Word, let your voice confirm,
That's done in the name of the Lord.

lyrics:
[Verse]
He's more than enough,
More than enough,
He is El Shaddai,
The God of plenty,
The all sufficient One,
God Almighty.

[Verse]
Go free in the name of Jesus,
Be whole in the name of the Lord,
Act on His Word, let your voice confirm,
That's done in the name of the Lord.
